providers.title: Providers and Models
providers.description: Added providers with their endpoints, authentication, headers and enabled models; keys are kept in the local credential store, not here

providers.title: Providers and Models
providers.description: Add providers, set keys, manage and check models

readOnly: The model service is not running; you can only view for now.

empty.title: No providers yet
empty.description: Add a provider and its key so the writing assistant can call models. Local Ollama and LM Studio are in the catalog too; for a relay, choose “Custom OpenAI-compatible provider”.

remove.label: Delete: {{name}}
remove.title: Delete provider “{{name}}”?
remove.roles: Roles using these models become unbound: {{roles}}. Features using them will report an error pointing to “Model Roles” until rebound.
remove.models_one: Its model is removed from the list and its key is deleted from the credential store.
remove.models_other: Its {{count}} models are removed from the list and its key is deleted from the credential store.

key.label: API key
key.hint: Kept in the local credential store, not in the settings file, and never shown again. Write env:NAME to read it from a startup environment variable.
key.empty: Paste an API key, or write env:NAME
key.stored: Set · type a new key to replace it
key.keyless: Leave empty if no key is needed
key.envFound: Read from the startup environment variable {{name}} (found).
key.envMissing: The environment variable {{name}} is not set: set it and restart the app.

url.label: Base URL
url.overridden: Changed to another URL; the catalog URL is {{url}}. Model capabilities and prices still follow the catalog.
url.invalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://

auth.label: Authentication
auth.hint: Which header carries the key. By default it follows the API format: Authorization: Bearer for OpenAI-style APIs, x-api-key for Anthropic

headers.label: Headers
headers.hint: Sent with every request; a model can add or override headers of the same name in its edit dialog

headers.name: Name
headers.credentialLike: Looks like a credential: write env:NAME so the value stays out of the settings file
headers.nameInvalid: Names may only use letters, digits and -_.!#$%&'*+^`|~

models.title: Models
models.empty: No models yet. Set a key, then use “Manage models” to add some.
models.checkTip: Check: send a very short request
models.incompleteTip: Fill in the context window to enable it
models.confirmDisable: After disabling, these roles cannot use it: {{roles}}.

kinds.network: Could not reach the provider, or the request was interrupted.
kinds.auth: Authentication failed: the provider rejected the key. Check it, or use a key that can access this model.
kinds.context_overflow: The request exceeded the context window.
kinds.local: A local problem: the configuration is incomplete or unusable.

edit.title: Edit model: {{name}}
edit.name: Display name
edit.priceHint: USD per million tokens; empty means unknown, 0 means free
edit.compactHint: Compact when the context reaches this size; empty means the window minus a reserve.
edit.headersHint: Overrides the provider's header of the same name
edit.catalogFixed: From the OMP model catalog; cannot be changed.
edit.idTaken: This id is already in the list
edit.headersPending: Some header rows are unfinished: complete or remove them before saving

manage.title: Manage models: {{name}}
manage.confirmRemove: After removing, these roles become unbound: {{roles}}.

add.title: Add provider
add.customHint: Relays, Volcano Ark, a local vLLM and so on: fill in the URL and API format

roles.intro: When a conversation has no model selected and the Profile names none, “Main” is used. A role without a model makes features using it report an error pointing here; no other model is used instead.

status.unknown-model: The bound model {{model}} is unavailable: gone from the catalog or disabled
status.no-credentials: The bound model {{model}} has no key

tiny.name: Tiny
tiny.description: Very small tasks such as titles and tags

fast.name: Fast
fast.description: Approval checks and background tasks that must be quick

compaction.name: Compaction
compaction.description: Writes summaries when compacting long conversations

roles.gradientHelp: Four fixed tiers from light to strong; system features each use one
roles.specialistHelp: Models bound by purpose; you can add your own

failure.write-conflict: It is being changed elsewhere at the same time; try again later
failure.settings-unavailable: The settings file has errors or cannot be written; fix it first
failure.credentials-unavailable: Could not read or write the credential store
failure.partially-applied: Only half of it was applied; the actual state is shown
failure.model-incomplete: A custom model needs a context window before it can be enabled
failure.builtin-role: Built-in roles cannot be deleted or renamed
failure.not-supported: This provider does not support fetching the model list
failure.unavailable: The model service is not running
failure.unknown-outcome: It may not have been saved; the settings are authoritative
